errors.evidence: The x-axis scale is not linear; the distances between 1%, 5%, 10%, 20%, 50%, 80%, and 100% are not uniform.
The x-axis does not have a uniform step of 1%. The ticks are at 1%, 5%, 10%, 20%, 50%, 80%, and 100%.
The y-axis range shown in the figure is from 80 to 94, not from 90.31 to 94.
The y-axis tick interval is 2 (e.g., 80, 82, 84), not three. The phrase '以三个数字间隔显示' is also ambiguous.
The starting point on the x-axis is 1%, where the F1-score is 80.42, not 86.39 (which is the value at 5%).
The ending point on the x-axis is 100%, where the F1-score is 93.01, not 92.83 (which is the value at 50%).
